name: Oscar Jacobson
verdict: A Swedish menswear and golfwear brand in Scandinavian Heritage, a portfolio company of the Andersson family's Mellby Gård group. Nothing found.
note: Southern Guards GC team partner 2026 (livgolf.com/southern-guards-gc, opened 2026-10-03). Chain: Oscar Jacobson -> Scandinavian Heritage (Oscar Jacobson says it has been 'part of Scandinavian Heritage' since 2025) -> Mellby Gård, which describes itself as a family-owned long-term investor (mellby-gaard.se, opened 2026-10-03). No state or fund capital, no human-rights findings found.
